name: Tsuyoki Iro-onna no Destination
original_name: 強き色女のデスティネーション
source:
The summer season, a certain holiday.

Virginal anime otaku and college student Retsu Takizawa
crosses paths with a local thug, which is where he first meets
pretty "yankee" Rin Urashima.

At a fireworks festival they meet again... and fall in love.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133411.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
夏日某个假期。

处男动画宅、大学生泷泽烈与当地混混相遇，也因此第一次遇见漂亮的“不良少女”浦岛凛。

烟花大会上两人再次相遇……并坠入爱河。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE133411.html]DLsite English[/url]]
